ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, nav links, icons, body copy — near-absolute dominance means the system runs on contrast, not on color

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page background and card surfaces; the default canvas everything sits on

mist-gray.$description: Mist Gray — Soft surface for secondary cards and section bands; lifts content off the white canvas without introducing a new hue

pale-blush.$description: Pale Blush — Warm section background (hero, accent bands) — the signature warmth of the brand, not a tint of any other color

faded-lilac.$description: Faded Lilac — Disabled or muted control surface — barely visible, intentionally recessive

iris-violet.$description: Iris Violet — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

indigo-depth.$description: Indigo Depth — Hover and pressed state of the Iris Violet button; deeper shift of the same hue for state feedback

forest-teal.$description: Forest Teal — Teal supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

whereby-roslindale-display-condensed.$description: Display headlines (hero, section titles). Custom condensed serif used at 80–120px is a signature choice — most SaaS brands default to sans-serif display; this serif elevates copy to editorial weight

whereby-roslindale-text.$description: Card titles and mid-size headings; same family as display but in a text cut with more comfortable proportions for shorter lines

inter.$description: Body copy, navigation, button labels, tags. Weight 500 for nav and labels, 600 for emphasized UI text. Negative tracking tightens Inter at 18px to match the editorial density of the serif

system-sans.$description: Fallback rendering layer; not used in primary composition but extracted as the underlying stack

inter-medium.$description: Inter-Medium — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

inter-semibold.$description: Inter-SemiBold — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
